items.title: Strengthening the Guest Experience: How Bespoke Hotels is Using Canary Across its UK Portfolio
items.snippet: Bespoke Hotels deployed Canary Technologies across its 57-property UK portfolio, recovering implementation costs within weeks and gaining consolidated reporting, upsell revenue, and guest data from OTA bookings.

items.title: Keralam Hotels to Stop UPI Payments Above INR 2,000
items.snippet: The Kerala Hotel and Restaurant Association (KHRA) has announced that its members will stop accepting UPI payments exceeding INR 2,000 from October 15, protesting the introduction of a 0.4% merchant discount rate (MDR) on eligible UPI transactions. The association said the additional charge would increase operating costs for hotels, restaurants and lodges already facing rising raw material prices. KHRA president G.

items.title: Radisson Targets 500 Hotels in India, Sharpens Focus on Metros
items.snippet: Radisson Hotel Group is redirecting a larger share of its India expansion towards metropolitan and other major cities while continuing to explore smaller markets, as it works towards a portfolio of 500 hotels by 2030. The strategy marks a shift in emphasis for the group, which built an early presence in India’s tier-two and tier-three cities and is now looking to capture further opportunities in larger urban markets.

items.title: Canadian Trips to U.S. Rise for Sixth Straight Month — but Remain Far Below 2024 Levels
items.snippet: Skift Take: Six months of growth sounds like momentum until you check the baseline. Climbing out of an unusually soft 2025 isn’t the same as getting back to normal. Canadian travelers are gradually returning to the U.S. — but the road back to 2024 levels remains a long one.

items.title: Tathastu Pench expands to 84 rooms, strengthens group business
items.snippet: Tathastu Resorts has expanded Tathastu Pench to 84 rooms, adding 23 keys and increasing its dining capacity to attract a wider mix of corporate groups, social gatherings, family holidays and experiential leisure travellers. The expansion aims to strengthen the property’s positioning beyond its established wildlife tourism business and promote Pench as a destination in its own right.

items.title: Ruby makes its France debut with the Ruby Lilou in Marseille
items.snippet: IHG Hotels & Resorts' lifestyle brand is opening its first French hotel in the La Joliette district of Marseille. The Ruby Lilou has 237 rooms and comes with a shared workspace, Ruby Yani, a first for the brand in France.

items.title: What hotel owners should consider when converting to a soft brand
items.snippet: Hoteliers should assess the unique opportunities and challenges of soft brands, while striving to maintain their individuality, experts shared at this year’s Lodging Conference. PHOENIX — Faced with rising costs and other operational challenges, hoteliers are evaluating different ways to drive returns at their properties.

items.title: Delhi HC bench asks single judge to explain curbs on PepsiCo
items.snippet: The company approached the HC against the Food Safety and Standards Authority of India's (FSSAI) order asking manufacturers of high-caffeine beverages to stop using the "energy drink" descriptor on their products, terming it a misleading claim.

items.title: Protests, traffic curbs in Delhi hit hotel business
items.snippet: Protests in Delhi are causing significant disruptions, leading to a notable decline in hotel occupancies across the city. Companies have chosen to cancel events and meetings to avoid travel difficulties amid ongoing unrest. Many hotels report F&B sales dropping significantly because of reduced guest activity and restricted access.
